2607.02214.title: Unlocking Speech-Text Compositional Powers: Instruction-Following Speech Language Models without Instruction Tuning
2607.02214.paper_summary: Instruction tuning for speech language models (SLMs) is substantially more challenging than for text-based large language models (LLMs), as it requires learning a new modality and a wide range of speech-specific instructions in addition to those supported by text LLMs. Existing SLM training approaches largely replicate the text LLM training paradigm by synthesizing large-scale speech pre-training and instruction-tuning datasets. However, this strategy is difficult to scale, since speech sequences are significantly longer than text sequences. In this paper, we propose SpeechCombine, an instruction-following speech language model trained without any instruction tuning, using only a single round of speech pre-training on 30k hours of data. Starting from a text LLM base model, we perform continuous pre-training on speech utterances to obtain a speech-adapted model, and then directly combine its weights with the weight difference between the instruction-tuned and base versions of the text LLM. Our results show that this simple combination strategy not only preserves the knowledge and capabilities of the original text LLM, but also effectively transfers them to the speech domain. These findings suggest a new direction for SLM training that avoids reliance on massive speech data.
2607.02214.paper_summary_zh: 指令調整對於語音語言模型（SLMs）來說，遠比對文本基礎的大型語言模型（LLMs）更具挑戰性，因為它需要學習一種新的模態以及一系列特定於語音的指令，這些指令除了文本 LLMs 支持的指令之外，還包括其他指令。現有的 SLM 訓練方法主要通過合成大規模語音預訓練和指令調整數據集來複製文本 LLM 訓練範式。然而，這一策略難以擴展，因為語音序列的長度顯著長於文本序列。在本文中，我們提出了 SpeechCombine，這是一個不需要任何指令調整的指令跟隨語音語言模型，僅使用 30,000 小時數據進行一次語音預訓練。從文本 LLM 基礎模型開始，我們對語音語句進行持續預訓練，以獲得一個適應語音的模型，然後將其權重與指令調整版本和文本 LLM 基礎版本之間的權重差直接結合。我們的結果顯示，這一簡單的組合策略不僅保留了原始文本 LLM 的知識和能力，還有效地將其轉移到語音領域。這些發現為 SLM 訓練提供了一個新的方向，避免依賴大量的語音數據。
